newsitem.title: USA: Motorola's iDEN to be used in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Motorola's iDEN to be used in Colombia.

text.p: Motorola Inc's Land Mobile Products Sector (LMPS) said Tuesday Avantel SA will launch a digitial wireless communications network in Bogota, Colombia, using Motorola's iDEN technology.
A Motorola subsidiary owns 40 percent of Avantel.

The iDEN technology (Integrated Digital Enhanced Network) provides two-way and group communications, telephone, and voice and text messaging. Data transmission is also possible in Colombia's largest cities, the company said.
Avantel will initially offer service in Bogota and plans to expand to Barranquilla, Bucaramanga, Cali, Cartagena and Medellin.

"The extensive need for telecommunications services in Colombia presents tremendous opportunities for iDEN," said Jim Osborn, vice president of Motorola and general manager of the LMPS's Worldwide Network Services Division.
